verdicts.rewritten_summary: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office travel advisory (as covered by Sahara Reporters, 2026-08-19): same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Nigeria with penalties up to 14 years' imprisonment; the prohibition also reaches people who help arrange or conduct same-sex marriages and anyone involved in gay groups or organisations (registering, organising). The advisory notes some states operate under Sharia law, where same-sex conduct can attract the death penalty, and warns of attacks on LGBT+ travellers.
